evidence.parameter_basis: Ideal endmember formulas and process relationships follow the cited petrology synthesis. The mafic-ultramafic, intermediate-to-felsic volcanic, alkaline-carbonatitic-kimberlitic, pyroclastic, sedimentary, surficial, pelitic slate-phyllite-to-schist, basalt-derived greenschist-to-amphibolite-to-granulite, sandstone-to-quartzite and limestone-to-marble, and ultramafic-to-serpentinite expansions follow published classification and USGS relationships documented in the public architecture. Andesite uses a plagioclase-dominant porphyritic crystalline proxy with amphibole, pyroxene, biotite, olivine, and oxide phases; rhyolite uses a quartz-alkali-feldspar-plagioclase-biotite stony flow-banded proxy. The alkaline recipe is a quartz-free nepheline-syenite proxy dominated by alkali feldspar and nepheline with aegirine; the carbonatite proxy remains more than 50 volume-percent primary calcite and dolomite and carries fluorapatite, oxide, mica, silicate, and sulfide accessories. Rare-earth and niobium ore minerals, sodic amphiboles, exsolution textures, fenitization, ring-complex zoning, and lineage fertility remain unresolved. Kimberlite uses an olivine-macrocryst, serpentine-phlogopite-calcite groundmass proxy with titanate, oxide, apatite, and sulfide accessories. Diamond grade and candidate mantle-indicator identities remain separate typed cargo state: the carrier recipe contains no diamond, pyrope, or chromite, while ilmenite and diopside may occur both as carrier phases and potential cargo indicators. Cargo stays source-context-unresolved with zero diamond grade until cratonic-keel and diamond-forming provenance exists. Pyroclastic rock uses a glass-rich welded ash-flow-tuff proxy with rhyolitic glass, quartz, feldspar, biotite, oxide, and amphibole fragments. The glass chemistry is a closed dry rhyolitic oxide-normalized proof proxy, not a universal analysis; primary eruptive source, transport, cooling-unit zoning, welding grade, devitrification, alteration, and reworking remain unresolved. Glassy, vesicular, and vitrophyric lava variants remain outside the crystalline lava recipes. Laterite-bauxite uses an aluminum-hydroxide, iron-oxide, and kaolinite residual proxy with gibbsite and boehmite; soil-colluvium uses a loose weathered mineral mixture; glacial till uses an unsorted matrix-rich felsic-mafic-carbonate proxy. None contains native gold or implies an ore deposit. Parent-material provenance, soil horizons and organics, slope transport, glacial erosion and transport, climate gates, profile zoning, and surface-body geometry remain unresolved. Saprolite stays a host-preserving weathering response rather than becoming a parentless primary recipe. Hornblende is represented by simplified hydroxyl magnesiohornblende-ferrohornblende endmembers, not by the lower-aluminum actinolite proxy used in greenschist; high-grade mafic granulite uses an anhydrous plagioclase-orthopyroxene-clinopyroxene-garnet proxy rather than retaining amphibolite's dominant hornblende. Lizardite, chrysotile, and antigorite use one simplified ideal serpentine-group formula while remaining separate texture and temperature proxies; serpentinite records a shallow low-temperature hydration proof path without claiming reaction-progress or water-rock mass-balance resolution. Non-crystalline organic matter and volcanic glass use explicit closed bulk-element proxies rather than fictitious mineral formulas. Primary metamorphic recipes author a non-metamorphic original protolith plus coarse grade, facies, path, and peak P-T envelope; they are not independent decorative rock rolls. Quartzite and marble are authored at one low-grade regional proof envelope even though those composition-and-texture rock classes occur across broader metamorphic conditions. Contact hornfels is an isochemical, host-preserving response with an explicit hornfelsic resolved texture rather than a fixed-composition primary lithology; the original rock still controls its mineralogy. Solid-solution states use ideal endmember interpolation and deliberately omit activity, ordering, solvus, and exsolution models. Constituent modes, modal covariance axes, protolith-conditioned response targets, primary and resolved textures, physical-property distributions, P-T envelopes, and non-crystalline bulk chemistry are explicit Phase 2 proof tunables pending catalog-by-catalog geological review.
evidence.title: Principles of Igneous and Metamorphic Petrology
